settings.name: Collision damage
settings.description: How hard a collision hits. At 0 collisions push but never damage.

settings.name: Shields against collisions
settings.description: Full: the shield absorbs a collision. Weak: it absorbs it but drains four times as fast. None: collisions pass the shield and hit the blocks.

settings.name: Shield recharge
settings.description: How fast shields recharge.

settings.name: Jump charge speed
settings.description: How fast a jump drive charges. The energy a jump takes stays the same.

settings.name: Hull strength
settings.description: How many hit points every block has.

settings.name: Asteroid amount
settings.description: 1x is the former maximum preset. Scales requested counts, including home. Zero removes all asteroids. Placement can fall short in crowded fields.

settings.name: Asteroids per sector maximum
settings.description: Upper count limit, including home. Placement can produce fewer. Never exceeds 20480 or the shared content limit.

settings.name: Asteroid size
settings.description: Scales radii. Rocks are limited to fit their field and sector.

settings.name: Field size
settings.description: Scales field dimensions, including home, capped to the sector. Smaller fields may fit fewer rocks.

settings.name: Field occurrence
settings.description: Scales the chance a sector has fields, capped at 100%. Does not remove the guaranteed home field; use Asteroid amount for that.

settings.name: Asteroid spacing
settings.description: Scales clearance between rocks. Never less than nonoverlap spacing. Crowded fields may fit fewer rocks.

settings.name: Ore-bearing share
settings.description: Scales the fraction of rocks carrying ore, capped at 100%. Cannot add resources absent from a sector.

settings.name: Ore grade
settings.description: Scales grade within ore-bearing rocks, capped at 100%. Does not change which resources occur.

settings.name: Asteroids per sector
settings.description: Requested count per sector with fields, not per field. Clamps sampled counts. Placement may fall short. Amount/cap zero disables rocks; frequency zero never adds rocks to meet this minimum (home keeps its baseline field).

settings.name: Radius (metres, not diameter)
settings.description: Clamps sampled radius after the size multiplier; diameter is twice radius. Existing size classes remain weighted, not uniformly sampled. Rocks that cannot fit at the minimum are omitted.

settings.name: Radius (metres, not diameter) maximum
settings.description: Clamps the existing sampled distribution; does not replace it with uniform randomness.

settings.name: Sector richness
settings.description: Clamps sampled sector richness (0–1), after the home minimum. Richness affects the map label, ore-bearing fraction and sampled grade; it does not directly add a material.

settings.name: Sector richness maximum
settings.description: Clamps the existing sampled distribution; does not replace it with uniform randomness.

settings.name: Ore grade
settings.description: Clamps grade within ore-bearing rocks after the grade multiplier. 0–1 means 0–100%; this does not change how many rocks carry ore. Material grade limits apply afterwards.

settings.name: Ore grade maximum
settings.description: Clamps the existing sampled distribution; does not replace it with uniform randomness.

settings.name: Relative abundance
settings.description: Weights this material among resources already available in the sector. Zero removes its share; never adds it to an unavailable sector.

settings.name: Ore grade
settings.description: Clamps grade after the global grade range. Applies only to rocks carrying this material; 0–1 is 0–100%.

settings.name: Ore grade maximum
settings.description: Clamps the existing sampled distribution; does not replace it with uniform randomness.

settings.name: Gas cloud wispiness
settings.description: How soft and frayed gas clouds look: 0 is dense with a hard outline, 1 thins their outer gas into strands and gaps, 2 is the most. Changes only how clouds are drawn, never where they are.

settings.name: Sector size
settings.description: Sector edge length. Drive range and the blind-safe band scale with it; minimum jump distance stays fixed.

settings.name: Ordinary cloud diameter
settings.description: Longest box diameter; sampled uniformly, capped to one sector width to preserve neighbour queries.

settings.name: Ordinary cloud diameter maximum
settings.description: Longest box diameter; sampled uniformly, capped to one sector width to preserve neighbour queries.

settings.name: Huge cloud diameter
settings.description: Longest box diameter; sampled uniformly, capped to one sector width to preserve neighbour queries.

settings.name: Huge cloud diameter maximum
settings.description: Longest box diameter; sampled uniformly, capped to one sector width to preserve neighbour queries.

settings.name: Huge cloud chance
settings.description: Chance a candidate cloud uses the huge size range; separation can remove candidates.

settings.name: Per-cloud wispiness
settings.description: Deterministic per-cloud multiplier on gasWispiness. Drawing only; final wispiness capped at 2.

settings.name: Per-cloud wispiness maximum
settings.description: Deterministic per-cloud multiplier on gasWispiness. Drawing only; final wispiness capped at 2.

settings.name: Cold cloud chance
settings.description: Cold share of candidate clouds; separation can remove candidates.

settings.name: Lightning cloud chance
settings.description: Lightning share of candidates that are not cold; separation can remove candidates.
